score.finalText:
Implemented bulk delete endpoint for items at `POST /api/v1/items/bulk-delete`.

**Implementation details:**
- Created `ItemIdsToDelete` request model to accept a list of item UUIDs
- Added `bulk_delete_items()` endpoint that:
  - Validates non-empty ID list (400 error if empty)
  - Queries for items matching the provided IDs
  - Validates all items exist (404 error if none found)
  - Checks permissions — rejects (403 error) if user attempts to delete items they don't own (superusers bypass this check)
  - Deletes all authorized items and returns success message with count

**Test coverage (all 15 tests passing):**
- Happy path: bulk delete multiple items
- Edge cases: empty list, non-existent IDs, permission denied
- All existing item tests still pass (create, read, update, single delete)
